title: Apgar Score in 60 Seconds
description:
The Apgar score rates 5 signs (appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration) from 0 to 2 each, at 1 and 5 minutes after birth. Resuscitation should start before the 1-minute score if needed, and a low score alone doesn't prove asphyxia (AAP/ACOG).

Sources:
• StatPearls: APGAR Score (NBK470569): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29262097/
• AAP Committee on Fetus and Newborn, ACOG. The Apgar Score. Pediatrics 2015: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26416932/

✅ Fact-checked as of 23 Nov 2026. Medical evidence and guidelines change; check the sources above for updates.
